title: Giant attacks: telegraphed, avoidable, self-cleaning
intent: Give the Giant three attacks that are dangerous but always fair, and leave nothing behind when it dies or the run resets

attempts.approach: Debris wind-up signalled only by the Giant pulsing
attempts.failureReason: nothing showed on the ground where it would land until the throw; the test of a ground telegraph during every wind-up failed, so the wind-up now draws a reticle that tracks the player and locks at the throw

evidence.description: added the Giant and its attacks

each attack ran its phases on time, took 35, 40 and 25 when standing still and 0 when dodged with the keyboard; death mid-throw, run end mid-wind-up and restart mid-charge left no rock, telegraph, timer or extra object

constraints.statement: Every attack runs wind-up, active and recovery, and each wind-up shows its danger zone on the ground and is long enough to leave it at 180 px/s (slam 100 px in 900 ms, charge 40 px in 800 ms, debris 70 px in a 900 ms flight)
Giant attacks use no Phaser timers; they are timed from now in act, and halt, die and destroy drop the attack, the rock and the telegraph
Every hit on the player goes through ArenaScene.damagePlayer, so the invulnerability window and run end apply to attacks as to contact
